selection_rule: Use the smallest family-current standard-library toolchain, keep inherited sealed tools byte-stable, and add only reusable family-named coherence tools after the x1 freeze.
planned_snapshot_policy: Fresh additive detached D-drive snapshots with explicit lease state, clean Git status, normalized manifest parity, and no claim of independent reproduction.
compatibility_boundary: The v642-v3 project-round-robin tools and all earlier sealed tools remain byte-stable and are selected only for inherited replay. They are not relabeled as v642-v4 implementation.
draft_source_boundary: JSON Schema 2020-12 is contextual draft material only; the new tools use the Python standard library and stable RFC 8785 canonicalization boundary.
